networkCaveat: CDP throttles development module requests as well as runtime assets; fresh runtime-session workers incur module preparation traffic excluded from the /clang/ byte metric.
runtimeAssetReloadReason: This local Vite server serves .gz assets with Content-Encoding:gzip, so fetch exposes decompressed bodies. Existing persistent asset gates require the pinned stored representation: the whole-buffer bridge skips encoded responses and the streaming compiler stores a snapshot only when input is gzip. With HTTP cache disabled and fresh host memory after reload, runtime assets download again. Generated PCH bytes have their own verified persistent record and remain reusable.
